# HAProxy — load-balancer-cookie-prefix

The same two backends made sticky the other way round: `cookie JSESSIONID prefix` puts HAProxy inside the session id, prepending its server id on the way out (JSESSIONID=v1~ABC123) and stripping it on the way in. Every other load-balancing scenario in the repo synthesizes a separate cookie to avoid exactly this, so nothing else covers a session id round-tripping through a rewriting proxy.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/load-balancer-cookie-prefix/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# The same two backends as load-balancer, made sticky the other way round: one
# keyword, and the only scenario in this repo where a proxy rewrites the
# session id itself.
#
# Every other load-balancing scenario here — Apache, NGINX, Traefik and
# haproxy/http/load-balancer — synthesizes a *separate* affinity cookie
# precisely so that nothing has to touch JSESSIONID. `prefix` mode does touch
# it: HAProxy prepends its own server id on the way out (JSESSIONID=v1~ABC123)
# and strips it again on the way in, so Tomcat never sees the prefix and the
# browser never sees the bare id. That is a failure surface nothing else in the
# repo covers: a session id round-tripping through a rewriting proxy.
#
# Note that `prefix` does NOT consume TOMCAT_JVMROUTE. Prefix mode and Tomcat's
# `.<jvmRoute>` suffix are independent mechanisms that happen to compose
# (JSESSIONID=v1~ABC123.vaadin-1); reading the route out of the suffix instead
# would need a stick table, which no scenario here does.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80
    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    balance roundrobin

    # No `insert` and no `indirect`: the cookie already exists, this only
    # decorates it. `nocache` still applies — a shared cache must not store a
    # response carrying someone's prefixed session id.
    cookie JSESSIONID prefix nocache

    server vaadin-1 vaadin-1:8080 cookie v1
    server vaadin-2 vaadin-2:8080 cookie v2
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
